page.notes: The Greek in the second paragraph is only partly legible: the opening word after μὴ, the word before ἀγαθοποιοῦσα and the word after dicerisque are doubtful or illegible. The black-letter line is a German quotation set in bold black letter. The horizontal marks beneath the last line are show-through or stray marks and were not transcribed. The first paragraph is italic and continues from the previous page, so it is marked cont="true". The printed "I" before "Discimus" is a section numeral and is kept in the paragraph.
